3. **formatter.ts**: `ids.join(' | ')` — test expects comma-space `, ` separator, not ` | `.

| 3 | `src/formatter.ts` | `ids.join(' \| ')` — wrong separator; test expected `, ` | Changed to `ids.join(', ')` |
